# opstracer Provider

Manage OpsTracer on-call configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    opstracer = {
      source  = "c0x12c/opstracer"
      version = "~> 0.2.1"
    }
  }
}

# Or leave both unset and export OPSTRACER_API_URL and OPSTRACER_TOKEN.
provider "opstracer" {
  api_url = "https://api-control-plane.opstracer.ai"
  token   = var.opstracer_token
}

variable "opstracer_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) OpsTracer control-plane API URL. Falls back to OPSTRACER_API_URL, then https://api-control-plane.opstracer.ai.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Org-scoped bearer token. Falls back to OPSTRACER_TOKEN.
